authoring_method: Fresh semantic authorship from sanitized query wording and supplied normative contract only. No original labels, parser source, parser predictions, evaluator source, evaluation results, prior reviewer findings, development errors or development scores accessed.
outcome_semantics: LABEL_CONFIRMED records that the sanitized wording has a complete, unambiguous normative interpretation without query changes. It does not assert agreement with original labels, which remain unseen.
string_vocabulary_provenance: Decision, intent and sort enum vocabulary supplied separately as schema contract only, without case labels or outputs.
protected_span_convention: Protected spans include both quote delimiters and their literal contents; end offsets are exclusive.
